title: Rotate mimid's local_token on mimi.reviewcommit.com (printed into a session transcript)
description:
2026-11-22: while auditing the interop host I dumped
/etc/mimid/mimid.toml wholesale to inspect its sections, and the
local_token value was printed into the session transcript. AGENTS.md:
"Secrets never reach logs". My error; reported rather than left quiet.

What it is: the provider's loopback bearer credential for
local_listen = 127.0.0.1:8099 on dokr. Reaching it needs code execution
on the host or an SSH session, so this is not remotely exploitable on
its own, but it is a live credential now sitting in a transcript.

Rotate it: generate a new 32-octet hex value, write it to
/etc/mimid/mimid.toml (0600, root), restart mimid, and update anything
holding the old one. Note the agent's own token is separate
(/etc/mimid-agent/agent.toml) and was not exposed.

Also worth doing while there: the attachment link key is derived from
the AGENT's local token (HMAC-SHA256(local token,
'mimid-attachment-link-key-v1'), decision mimid-1wgh.88), so rotating
an agent token revokes every outstanding attachment link. That is the
agent's token, not this one, so this rotation does not invalidate links.

Procedure for next time, already adopted: read only section names and
key names from a remote config (grep '^\[' and the key names), never the
whole file.
